echo "=== GITHUB HEAD (after commits) ==="
curl -s -X POST https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/developer-deploy/action \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"action":"github_get_repo_head","input":{"branch":"main"}}' 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "
import sys,json
d=json.loads(sys.stdin.read())
if d.get('ok'):
    r=d.get('result',d)
    print(f'  headSha: {r.get(\"headSha\",\"?\")}')
    print(f'  message: {r.get(\"headCommitMessage\",\"?\")[:120]}')
    print(f'  date: {r.get(\"headCommitDate\",\"?\")}')
else:
    print(f'  ERROR: {d.get(\"error\",\"?\")}')
"

echo ""
echo "=== PRODUCTION HEALTH ==="
curl -s https://api.ivxholding.com/health 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "
import sys,json
d=json.loads(sys.stdin.read())
print(f'  status: {d.get(\"status\",\"?\")}')
print(f'  commit: {d.get(\"commit\",\"?\")}')
print(f'  bootTime: {d.get(\"bootTime\",\"?\")}')
print(f'  environment: {d.get(\"environment\",\"?\")}')
"
